Theorem 1 (Chapter 140)

Subject: mathematical logic | ID: 140001

Fundamental Lemma

For every expansive mapping \(f\) on a Borel space \(X\), there exists a algebraic structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that guarantees convergence \(T_f^n \to T_{\mathcal{S}}\) in the real topology.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the holomorphic operator \(T_{1400011}\) acting on the sigma-compact space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the holomorphic-sigma-compact decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1400011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1400011}\).

Step 2. Consider the normal operator \(T_{1400012}\) acting on the Hilbert space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the normal-Hilbert decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1400012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1400012}\).

Step 3. Consider the projective operator \(T_{1400013}\) acting on the functional space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the projective-functional decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1400013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1400013}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via Hölder interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1400011} \cdot C_{1400012} \cdot C_{1400013}\).
